articles.title: CPM is Keralam's dominant Hindu outfit: BJP leader on why
articles.summary: BJP leader KS Radhakrishnan stated on Wednesday in Kochi that the party's slow growth in Kerala stems from the Communist movement historically functioning as the dominant Hindu political force occupying that political space, which shapes voting patterns and state alliances.

articles.title: India, France Review Proposed EPR Technology Deployment
articles.summary: Senior officials from India and France met on Friday to review the proposed deployment of EPR technology and nuclear sector regulatory reforms. They also discussed pumped hydro storage projects and opportunities to expand energy infrastructure collaboration between the two nations.

articles.title: Biharis turn The Vvaan shows into Chhath celebration, offer thekua
articles.summary: Screenings of the folk thriller The Vvaan across Bihar have become sacred spaces. Viewers remove footwear outside halls, and women distribute thekua inside. Released on September 25, 2026, the Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia film reached 1,296 active shows today.

articles.title: DoorDash to create 3,000 jobs at global tech centre in India
articles.summary: DoorDash will create 3,000 jobs in India over the next two years through a new global technology hub in Hyderabad, its second tech office in the country after Pune. The centre will initially focus on customer support and administrative functions.

articles.title: The ‘AI IP deficit’: Will India become the world’s largest
articles.summary: On September 25, 2026, India’s Chief Economic Adviser, V. Anantha Nageswaran, asked whether India will actually own enough of the artificial intelligence it uses, because the country may soon become one of the world's largest consumers and deployers of AI.

articles.title: NDA moves to contain differences ahead of legislative council polls
articles.summary: The NDA in Bihar appeared to be moving to contain differences within its ranks ahead of the Oct 23 elections to eight legislative council seats, with LJP(RV) chief Chirag Paswan retracting his criticism of chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and JD(U) leadership indicating action to resolve a dispute between Mokama MLA Anant Singh and party spokesperson Neeraj Kumar.

articles.title: Shark stranded in South Korean canal becomes national celebrity, draws

articles.title: Rupee steadies near 96/$ as outflows weigh, RBI intervention cushions
articles.summary: The Indian rupee held near ninety-six per dollar on Wednesday in Mumbai. Foreign portfolio outflows weighed on the currency while central bank intervention provided support. The rupee traded at ninety-five point nine seven per dollar at eleven thirty a m.

articles.title: Fragmented road data may slow ADAS adoption in India: Here
articles.summary: Here Technologies stated that fragmented road data might slow the adoption of advanced driving assistance systems in India. The company noted that broader access to government-held speed limits, lane details, and road sign data would help scale these driving applications.

articles.title: Brazil's Raphinha will not travel to India for friendly

articles.title: Bihar kidnapping case: Youth abducted after car hits bike, rescued

articles.title: Apple Pay launches in India: Here's everything you need to know
articles.summary: Apple has launched its payment service in India through a collaboration with Axis Bank. Users holding Axis Bank cards can easily enact contactless transactions. The process of adding cards is straightforward with the Wallet app or the Axis Bank app.

articles.title: Govt notifies new CAFE-3 norms for passenger vehicles
articles.summary: The Indian government notified new Corporate Average Fuel Economy norms, setting fuel-efficiency and carbon-emission limits for passenger vehicles from April 1, 2027, to March 31, 2032. The power ministry stated these norms apply to new passenger vehicles manufactured or imported.

articles.title: Gun in hand, civilian clothes: Bihar woman constable suspended over social media reel

articles.title: Goldy Brar on FBI Top 10 Wanted List, $1M Reward
articles.summary: The Federal Bureau of Investigation has added gangster Satinderjeet Singh, alias Goldy Brar, to its Ten Most Wanted Fugitives list, announcing a reward of up to one million US dollars for information leading to his capture. Brar is wanted on federal charges in the United States as an alleged leader of the Lawrence Bishnoi organised crime syndicate in North America. Authorities consider him armed and extremely dangerous, with operations spanning California and Canada. He was identified during Operation Hardball, an investigation tackling transnational organised crime syndicates. A past conversation revealed Brar admitting to the murder of singer Sidhu Moosewala, citing gang brotherhood and perceived arrogance. The report outlines an escalating feud between Brar and the Bishnoi syndicate following legal mishandling surrounding Anmol Bishnoi's deportation from America to India in 2025. Gang rivalries spanning California, Dubai, and Chandigarh have triggered retaliatory attacks and shootings, including incidents targeting associates and celebrities.
articles.title_hi: एफबीआई की शीर्ष 10 वांछित सूची में गोल्डी बरार, $1M का इनाम
articles.summary_hi: संघीय जांच ब्यूरो ने गैंगस्टर सतिंदरजीत सिंह उर्फ गोल्डी बराड़ को अपनी दस सर्वाधिक वांछित भगोड़ों की सूची में शामिल कर लिया है और उसे पकड़वाने में मदद करने वाली सूचना देने वाले को दस लाख अमेरिकी डॉलर तक का इनाम देने की घोषणा की है। बरार उत्तरी अमेरिका में लॉरेंस बिश्नोई संगठित अपराध सिंडिकेट के कथित नेता के रूप में संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में संघीय आरोपों में वांछित है। कैलिफ़ोर्निया और कनाडा तक फैले अभियानों के साथ, अधिकारी उसे सशस्त्र और बेहद खतरनाक मानते हैं। उनकी पहचान ऑपरेशन हार्डबॉल के दौरान की गई थी, जो अंतरराष्ट्रीय संगठित अपराध सिंडिकेट से निपटने के लिए एक जांच थी। पिछली बातचीत से पता चला कि बराड़ ने गिरोह के भाईचारे और कथित अहंकार का हवाला देते हुए गायक सिद्धू मूसेवाला की हत्या की बात स्वीकार की थी। रिपोर्ट में 2025 में अनमोल बिश्नोई के अमेरिका से भारत निर्वासन के आसपास कानूनी गड़बड़ी के बाद बराड़ और बिश्नोई सिंडिकेट के बीच बढ़ते झगड़े की रूपरेखा दी गई है। कैलिफोर्निया, दुबई और चंडीगढ़ में फैली गिरोह प्रतिद्वंद्विता ने जवाबी हमले और गोलीबारी शुरू कर दी है, जिसमें सहयोगियों और मशहूर हस्तियों को निशाना बनाने की घटनाएं भी शामिल हैं।
